home.title:
HEY.
I'M DORAEMON.
home.intro: A quiet little fan-made archive for the blue robot cat, Nobita, the gadgets, the adventures and the strange little moments that make this universe special.
home.note: No accounts. No feeds. Just Doraemon.

characters.name: Doraemon
characters.title: THE GADGET KEEPER.
characters.text: A 22nd-century robotic cat with a 4D pocket full of impossible-looking solutions. Usually helpful. Occasionally chaotic.

characters.name: Nobita Nobi
characters.title: THE ONE WHO ASKS.
characters.text: Kind-hearted, unlucky at times, endlessly imaginative — and almost always one gadget away from making a small problem much bigger.

characters.name: Shizuka Minamoto
characters.title: THE STEADY ONE.
characters.text: Smart, caring and thoughtful. Shizuka is one of the people who keeps Nobita's world grounded.

characters.name: Takeshi Gouda
characters.title: THE LOUD ONE.
characters.text: Known as Gian. Strong, confident and famous among his friends for performances that are difficult to forget.

characters.name: Suneo Honekawa
characters.title: THE FLEX.
characters.text: A collector of stories, toys and possessions — and never particularly shy about showing them off.

characters.name: Dorami
characters.title: THE RELIABLE ONE.
characters.text: Doraemon's younger sister. Yellow, capable and often more sensible than her brother.

gadgets.name: Anywhere Door
gadgets.text: A door that can connect you to another destination. The ultimate shortcut.

gadgets.name: Take-copter
gadgets.text: A tiny rotor that turns an ordinary afternoon into a flight.

gadgets.name: 4D Pocket
gadgets.text: Doraemon's four-dimensional storage space — the reason almost anything can appear at exactly the wrong moment.

gadgets.name: Time Machine
gadgets.text: A route through time, usually accessed beneath Nobita's desk.

gadgets.name: Memory Bread
gadgets.text: A famous gadget-food idea associated with memorising written information.

gadgets.name: What-If Phone Booth
gadgets.text: Imagine an alternate world where a hypothetical condition becomes reality.

jokes.text:
Nobita: I have a plan.
Doraemon: That's usually how the trouble starts.

The 4D Pocket has everything.
Except apparently a gadget that makes Nobita do homework himself.

Nobita discovers a shortcut to success.
He immediately takes a shortcut around the shortcut.

Gian: I'm going to sing one song.
The neighbourhood: We need a gadget.

Me: I'll use the internet for five minutes.
The internet: Here's a 42-minute Doraemon compilation.
